svg.title: Point contact events, Coulomb friction, and energy counterexamples
svg.desc: C/D/E use mass 1 kg, initial height 1 m and vx 1.5 m/s. Exact event pre/post velocities are inserted at the same time to show jumps, not a fictitious ramp. Four fixed cases use single point contact without spin. F is a separate vertical-only elastic drop (initial 9.81 J), contrasting exact event handling with two declared wrong coarse projections.

cc:Work.dc:title: Point contact events, Coulomb friction, and energy counterexamples
